csg_union_demo.name: CSG Union Demo
csg_union_demo.description: Two CSG primitives combined with the union operator. Visualizes A union B as a single composite solid.
csg_union_demo.qfep_connection: A∪B: two solids declared one. The gentlest Boolean, and the one that hides the most — union looks like putting things next to each other, but it fuses them, the seam between them dissolved into a single skin. The chapter's opening insistence that composition is not a pile: the moment two forms join, their boundary is renegotiated, and the inside of the whole is more than the sum of the insides.

csg_intersection_demo.name: CSG Intersection Demo
csg_intersection_demo.description: Two CSG primitives with intersection operator. Only the overlap survives.
csg_intersection_demo.qfep_connection: A∩B: only the overlap survives. The strictest operator — intersection keeps solely the space both solids agreed to occupy and discards everything else, so two large forms can yield a tiny sliver or nothing at all. The primitive of the joint: where two things meet is not where they touch but where they *coincide*, and this operator is the chapter's tool for finding that shared interior.

csg_difference_demo.name: CSG Difference Demo
csg_difference_demo.description: A box with a sphere subtracted. The operator that makes cavities and openings.

dna.default: workings=outcome, strike=corner - both defaults are short-circuits, not recomputations. outcome builds nothing beyond the single CSGCombiner the artifact always built, and corner returns the raw sphere_offset (0.3, 0.1, 0.3) untouched instead of resolving a fraction of box_size, so all 27 placements are bit-identical. None of the 27 passes a config key at all, and a placement that names sphere_offset directly still overrides strike.
dna.was: one carved box, rotating, with a Label3D reading 'A - B' and nothing else. sphere_offset is the artifact's own declared critical_parameter ('where the bite lands') and was reachable only as an unnamed Vector3; apply_grid_config assigned body_color and had no rebuild behind it, so the knob it did expose could not take effect after _ready.
dna.note: This is fontana_puncture's direct sibling - the same cube-minus-sphere, one as art and one as demonstration - so strike is reused from it word for word and value for value. What differs, said plainly: the NUMBERS are not fontana's and cannot be. Its sphere is 1.36 half-extents, this one's is 1.10, so the same fraction cuts a different topology; and its 'corner' is a body diagonal while the value shipped here is an XZ diagonal sitting low. The two agree on the word and the list and each resolves it against its own geometry, which is what makes them comparable rather than merely identical. workings is the axis a demonstration wants and an artwork does not: how much of the operation it is willing to show. outcome = only the answer; trace = the removed material (A intersect B) put back as a translucent ghost in the cavity it left, which is 'absence is constructive' rendered rather than asserted; operands = the uncut box and the subtracting sphere faint and in place; expression = the operands plus sphere_offset drawn as a rod between the two centres, with both terms labelled. Word and value list taken character for character from geometric_transformations, bounce_well, transform_composition_workbench and the vector_op console.
dna.declined: breach, fontana's amount axis, is NOT promoted here: the radius is fixed at 0.55 against a 1.0 box and this artifact's declared critical parameter is the offset, so a second amount axis would repeat the family's existing claim and add nothing a demo argues. The non-commutative B - A that the @identity asks for is a real third demonstration and belongs beside this object, not inside workings - B - A is not a different amount of showing, it is a different thing shown.
dna.fixture_why: The rig spins at 0.35 rad/s, so the sweep photographs each variant at whatever yaw the settle happened to land on. Pinning it to zero costs about seven degrees against the shipped look and makes strike measurable instead of arbitrary; centred, raised and grazing move on Y and are legible from any yaw regardless.
dna.rebuild_guard: apply_grid_config now compares a signature of every value the build reads and returns early when nothing changed, so a placement re-announcing its config no longer rebuilds. The ghosts hang off a plain Node3D rig rather than the combiner: a CSGCombiner3D nested inside another combiner is a shape, not a container, and would have unioned the trace ghost back into the solid it comments on. The rig rotates about the same axis the combiner did (the offset is purely vertical), so the world transform is unchanged.

csg_difference_demo.qfep_connection: A−B: the box remembers the sphere by its absence. Difference is the operator of cavities and openings — subtract one solid from another and what remains is shaped by a thing no longer there, the hollow a negative portrait of what was removed. The walk's central power: every window, every socket, every carved bowl is a subtraction, form defined by a precise act of taking-away.

dna.default: algebra=triad, strike=corner - PRESERVES all seven placements exactly, and both defaults are short-circuits rather than recomputations. _recipe() at triad returns the same three dictionaries _build_presets used to hold inline, in the same order, with the same colours and the same labels; the bench width formula preset_spacing * (count + 0.2) evaluates at count=3 to preset_spacing * 3.2, the literal that shipped, and the layout formula (i - (count-1)/2) * preset_spacing evaluates to (i - 1) * preset_spacing, likewise the literal. strike=corner returns preset_offset (0.2, 0.1, 0.1) untouched instead of resolving a fraction of box_size. All seven placements are bare tokens passing no config keys at all, plus two reach-paths through curation_station whose #with_wall / #with_pillars / #with_barrier flags belong to the station and are never forwarded here. A placement that names preset_offset directly still wins over strike.
dna.was: no declared axis - the runner refused this token for NO TURNABLE KNOBS. Three exports existed and none of them was an argument: bench_color is palette, rotation_speed is a rate and invisible to a still, preset_spacing is the declared critical_parameter and a distance. The operator SET - the thing the artifact exists to hold - was a three-element literal array inside _build_presets, and the operand pair (box 0.45, sphere r 0.3 at (0.2, 0.1, 0.1)) was three more literals in the loop below it. apply_grid_config assigned preset_spacing with no rebuild behind it, so the one knob it exposed could not take effect after _ready.
dna.note: algebra is a NEW word. Nothing in the corpus asks what a closed operator set consists of; the nearest neighbours ask about one operation's depth (fontana_puncture's breach) or its exposition (workings). triad is Godot's three CSG primitives and the three the bracelet offers. ordered adds B - A beside A - B, and that pair is the entire proof that difference is the only non-commutative operator here - which is exactly the demonstration csg_difference_demo declined to swallow into its own workings and deferred to 'a second object beside this one'. This is that object. complete adds the symmetric difference, built as a nested (A union B) combiner minus a nested (A intersect B) combiner, and labelled longhand rather than as a symbol because the label IS the claim: XOR is derivable and is not a primitive of the tool. atoms drops the operators entirely for the three disjoint regions A-B, A intersect B, B-A that every one of them is a union of - three benches again, and the identical count is the point, since the room looks like the shipped one while arguing the opposite thing. strike is reused CHARACTER FOR CHARACTER from fontana_puncture and csg_difference_demo: same word, same four values, same question. The numbers are not theirs and cannot be - fontana's sphere is 1.36 half-extents, the demo's 1.10, this bench's 1.33 (r 0.3 against a 0.225 half-extent) - so the same fraction of box_size cuts a different topology in each, which is what makes the three comparable rather than merely identical. On this artifact it does something neither sibling can: one offset drives every operator on the bench at once, so the axis puts the bench's own claim (that these are one family) under load. At centred the union is a ball with eight box corners through it, the intersection is that ball flattened on six faces, and the difference breaches all six faces so the box survives as its twelve edges - three unmistakably different solids from a single placement of B.
dna.declined: workings (outcome | trace | operands | expression), the twelve-artifact family word, genuinely FITS this artifact and is still not shipped. The sibling already holds it: csg_difference_demo's promotion is precisely how much of ONE operation is drawn, and repeating it here across up to five presets would fill the frame with translucent ghosts and say the family's existing thing five times over. The hub's question is the set, the demo's question is the derivation; kept apart the two artifacts are comparable, merged one of them is redundant. Also declined: an axis over preset_spacing, the declared critical_parameter. It is a distance, and a distance is legible as a number - it does not need a vocabulary laid over it.
dna.fixture_why: Every preset root spins at 0.25 rad/s from the first frame, so without this the sweep photographs each variant at whatever yaw its settle happened to land on and the diff measures rotation instead of the axis. rotation_speed is a plain float export read only by _process, so pinning it to zero holds the presets at the yaw they have at spawn - the shipped look at t=0, not a new one. Numeric and not the string '0.0': the sweep assigns fixture values straight onto the property before _ready, where a String would be rejected by the typed float.
dna.rebuild_guard: apply_grid_config now stamps config into metadata, re-reads it, and returns early unless a value the build actually reads has changed - and returns immediately if _ready has not built yet. The old body assigned preset_spacing and had no rebuild at all, which worked only because config always arrives before _ready. All seven placements pass no keys, so the guard means none of them is even torn down.
dna.still_note: everything both axes build is standing CSG geometry resolved during _ready. There is no animation on this bench except the yaw the fixture pins, so a single frame is a complete account of both values.

csg_compose_workbench.name: CSG Compose Workbench
csg_compose_workbench.description: Workbench holding all three CSG operators side by side. The introduction artifact for the csg-compose catalyst affordance.
csg_compose_workbench.qfep_connection: All three operators on one bench — union, intersection, difference, side by side, the chapter's grammar laid out as a palette. The workbench where you learn that solids have an algebra: any complex form is a sentence in these three verbs, and constructive solid geometry is the claim that you can say any shape by combining primitives lawfully enough.

csg_architecture_cavity.name: CSG Architecture Cavity
csg_architecture_cavity.description: A solid wall with three openings cut through it. Architecture as Boolean composition.
csg_architecture_cavity.qfep_connection: A wall with three openings cut clean through it — architecture reduced to its Boolean truth. The turn's demonstration that building is subtraction: a doorway is a difference, a room is a void bounded by solid, and the mass of a wall exists to be selectively removed. Standing before it you read architecture the way this chapter teaches — not as material placed, but as space composed, the cavity the real subject and the wall merely its frame.

coincident_face.description: The boolean-surfaces seam. CSG promises exact cuts; subtract one solid from another and the boundary is a clean surface. But when the cut plane lands on a coincident face, the two surfaces claim the same depth and the float grid cannot say which is in front - so the renderer flickers, awarding each pixel to whichever number rounded higher this frame. The clean boolean is exact everywhere except the one place you asked it to be.
coincident_face.name: Coincident Face
coincident_face.qfep_connection: A station in the bias landscape (doc/SEAM_PER_SEQUENCE.md); the digital-bias seam for boolean_surfaces. Bias is conserved; show the seam.
